name: Fisher Auto Parts
old_description: In 1929, when our country was entering the great depression, Blair Coiner founded his company with high hopes, perseverance and determination.
about:
Fisher Auto Parts traces its roots to 1929 in Weston, West Virginia, when Blair Coiner founded Coiner Parts during the Great Depression. Coiner began by supplying auto parts to car dealers, service stations, and independent garages, emphasizing high-character dealer service.

The company rebranded as Fisher Auto Parts in 1983 after expanding to 60 locations and 300 employees. Today, the headquarters in Weston operates with a staff of 18, overseeing a network of retail stores and Federated Car Care Centers. Fisher distributes quality name-brand parts from major manufacturers, offering an online catalog (Federated Link Catalog), safety data sheets, technical training, and maintenance resources such as tech tips and the "Two Guys Garage Tech Talk" series.

Fisher serves the automotive aftermarket, including car dealerships, service stations, repair garages, professional technicians, and retail customers. Its store locator and car care repair center locator connect drivers and shops with local inventory and service.

Founded on perseverance and a commitment to exceeding expectations in value, quality, and service, Fisher differentiates itself through fast, dependable delivery and a focus on pleasing each customer with the service they deserve.
